about.title: About me
about.text: I'm an electromechanical technician and have worked in industry since 2013: first in industrial refrigeration and, since 2017, at B.Braun in a regulated pharmaceutical plant. In 2023 I started teaching myself to code, and today I build full apps, using AI as a working tool. From industry I bring a methodical approach to troubleshooting, a habit of documenting and working under strict standards, and a focus on things working every single day.

nexindu.line: Maintenance management software (CMMS) for regulated pharmaceutical plants.
bullets: Work orders, preventive maintenance and spare-parts inventory
Immutable audit trail with e-signatures (FDA 21 CFR Part 11, ALCOA+)
AI assistant (Gemini) with RAG over plant documentation
Playwright E2E tests and CI with security scanning (CodeQL, OWASP ZAP)

nexkio.line: Offline-first point-of-sale system for small shops.
bullets: PWA: keeps selling when the internet goes down

nexquipu.line: Family finances built from credit-card statements.
bullets: Reads the PDF statement and categorizes spending

nexpulse.line: Blind timer for home poker tournaments, with P2P remote control over WebRTC.

nexplay.line: Real-time online board games for family play (Supabase Realtime).
